title: Apex Group joins Hedera Council to explore tokenization and settlement
snippet: Apex Group, overseeing $3.5 trillion in assets, joins the Hedera Council and will explore Hedera for tokenization, compliance and settlement.

title: THE BLOCK: MSCI will remove Strategy $MSTR from its USA Index at the close of Nov. 30, its November review confirms. The bitcoin treasury giant previously pushed back against MSCI's new rules against non-operating compan
snippet: THE BLOCK: MSCI will remove Strategy $MSTR from its USA Index at the close of Nov. 30, its November review confirms. The bitcoin treasury giant previously pushed back against MSCI's new rules against non-operating companies, calling them "discriminatory" against digital asset treasuries.
